notes.title: Achievement fixes and option to disable Goblin Invasion
notes.content:
Small updates:

- There was a bug with unlocking the "Monster Chef" achievement that has been fixed. Now, if you have completed everything, you can simply enter the level and "Monster Chef" will unlock if you have all the other achievements, even if you have deleted the save game and restarted the game.

- The electrician cat was preventing the "Fix the power panel 5 times" achievement. Now, if he prevents a power outage, you will get this notification and it will count towards the achievement. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266199/f7caa16291ba32761394f2007789eb19931d4a53.png[/img]

- I added a option to disable the goblin invasions, it is in the new tab of settings "Accessibility". This will not prevent the first invasion after the letters in the elevator, but it will prevent all random invasions. You can disable this option at any time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266199/54e1fb968a1b4e8add7f92c8304d029708dd1af4.png[/img]

notes.title: Release Date and Price Reveal
notes.content:
After a long time without posting, I'm excited to announce the release date and price.

[b]Date: April 24th.[/b]

About the price...

It's pretty common for simulators to cost between $10 and $15, which is fine, but since this is my first simulator game and I don't want the price to be a deal breaker for you, [b]the price will be $6.99 MINUS a generous launch discount[/b], which won't go below that for a long time.

For those interested in the differences between the demo and the final game:
- New recipes
- New monsters
- New appliances
- New ingredients
- Random events added
- New tasks
- New customizations
- Farming has been cut from the game (I know, it's a shame, but I didn't share anything about farming before because it wasn't good enough. Plus, I don't want to put something in the game just to increase the hours)

I appreciate all the support,
Bruno Bricchi

notes.title: German translation, refrigerator and bug fixes
notes.content:
I made small updates every week to fix small bugs and now this is the biggest update for the demo, just before the Steam Next Fest, here's what's new:

- Deutsch (German) Translation

- Refrigerator that can store up to 10 ready-made packages of each recipe

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266199/be9a1ebfc9360cf60b662cf13b177a56457e41b2.png[/img]

- 3 New options to customize your fast food (you can see the sci-fi one in the screenshot above)

And for the most important bug fixes and smaller additions (some of which I fixed weeks ago, but I'm talking about it now):

- Tutorial objective switching is now faster
- Burger meat sliding and falling behind grill is fixed
- Sound feedback when you delivers a wrong order
- Freezer egg count not being saved has been fixed
- Mug price fixed

notes.title: Updates before demo
notes.content:
After a playtest with hundreds of players and dozens of responses to the survey, here are the main updates coming to tomorrow's demo:

[h2]1. Translation[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266199/ce7e71a577f560c30466e28e938a1f2b3136e7ba.png[/img]

I'm not going to lie, it's not complete yet, but I'd say it's 95% there, with only non-relevant things not translated, like loading menu texts. I thought it would be easier, but dealing with different fonts, spacing and line breaks has been a [strike]nightmare[/strike]

[h2]2. Coins[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266199/5e121ae25b6bb8650b21e3bc994098e45ea584c8.gif[/img]

This one is self-explanatory, no longer “one by one”.

[h2]3. Human body physics[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266199/f96756016e044e876c510dfbd6dc823b4411e470.gif[/img]

Yeeei, physics to the [strike]meat[/strike]

[h2]4. Camera Shake[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266199/f8aef37e0caf7e65942a998af94459f6aa014de2.gif[/img]

Just disable the option in the "Controls" menu.

These are the ones I find most useful. Now to the "smaller" ones:

[b]5.[/b] Expanded lever collider
[b]6.[/b] More money on each sale (balance)
[b]7.[/b] 1 More meat produced in each human body 
[b]8.[/b] New window on the side of the meat processor lever, so you can see the [strike]damage[/strike]
[b]9.[/b] More content (1 new upgrade, 1 new recipe, 1 helper, customization)

And other small updates. That's it, see you tomorrow!

notes.title: Thanks for playing!
notes.content:
The playtest is over, and now the game will be available to play in the public demo in January.

Dozens of people helped out and responded to the survey, so I'm happy to say that I'm already fixing some of the “annoying things” you found. 

The public demo will have more recipes, Chinese, Japanese and Portuguese translations and more upgrades. 

I'll do a post soon detailing the fixes and additions for the demo.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Playtest is now live!
notes.content:
Playtest is now live! 
Play, have fun and share your thoughts with me!

For now, the playtest is only available in English, but the demo launch in mid-January will be translated into the languages ​​indicated on the Steam page.

For content creators, you have a button to access the in-game press kit, but you can also access it here: [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1IYKEGQ0Red9-9s87-vCtQ-0jP6nwNX4A?usp=sharing]CLICK HERE (Google Drive)[/url]

notes.title: Playtest Release Date
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266199/b13a649aa30351d9373c8bc221c84f262012013a.png[/img]

1,174 people clicked the button to take part in the playtest - and I'm very happy about that!

Some people have messaged me to get access, but the truth is that it's not available at the moment, only the button to request access is (in fact, Steam has already approved the build for the test, but it's not ready yet).

The playtest is planned to be released early December, to be more specific, I'll release it anywhere between the first and second week of December.

In addition, I'll be launching the public demo sometime in January and I'm planning to do this with more content than the playtest. 

At the moment, the playtest has between 1.5 and 2 hours of content.

I'll be back when it's time to launch, thanks!

[b]For content creators: [/b]Videos and posts about the game are totally allowed and I'm preparing a press kit to be released alongside the playtest.

- Bruno Bricchi

notes.title: Japanese Translation Added
notes.content:
The Japanese translation will be added to the final game and is already on the Steam page.

I'm very happy to have received a few thousand "accesses" on the Steam page, and most of them came from Japan (almost 40%).

I've also read some good comments from the Japanese community on social media.

I learned that the biggest reason for this amazing Japanese audience was the “Automaton” website, which covered my game in a post.

I also saw that they covered a wide variety of indie games, which is really amazing! I mean, in the West the press doesn't care about indie games that don't have millions in their pockets.

Anyway, I wanted to write something in Japanese, but my "Duo" lessons haven't paid off yet, so I'll just post a picture of my cat celebrating.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266199/3bd8880ff80258f469a2c8282e7cf53407d14bbd.png[/img]

- Bruno Bricchi
